purpose: Probability-free feasibility boundaries, not a forecast, promise, price target or trade instruction.
upstream_authorities: canonical company underwrites and live issue monitors

TAI-TECH.entry: NT$190–210 with revenue/margin acceleration and AI-mix direction intact.
TAI-TECH.add: <=NT$185 with thesis intact, or AI mix >=20% / named CSP, ASIC or next-generation qualification.
TAI-TECH.trim: Above about NT$350 before EPS and AI mix catch up materially.
TAI-TECH.sell: Reassess or exit if AI mix stalls in the low teens or TLVR pricing compresses margins.
TAI-TECH.thesis_break: Architecture reduces external magnetics content or company acceleration fails to convert into cash earnings.
TAI-TECH.driver_split: Primarily operating/EPS growth; premium valuation retention contributes in upside.
TAI-TECH.catalyst_sequence: Monthly revenue and earnings/margins -> AI mix 15–20% -> named CSP/ASIC or 800V production evidence.
TAI-TECH.downside_permanent_loss: Cyclical/automotive growth may be misattributed to AI; pricing and architecture substitution can impair the earnings bridge.
TAI-TECH.correlation: AI power; partially correlated with Impro and data-centre capex, less with robotics and nuclear.

Laifual.entry: Executable <=HK$48 with thesis intact; no chase above the condition.
Laifual.add: Only after positive cash/profit, repeat orders, durable about 28–30% reducer margin or backlog conversion without ASP concessions.
Laifual.trim: Cancel or trim if price exceeds the condition without stronger evidence or valuation outruns cash earnings.
Laifual.sell: Exit/reassess on material customer loss, margin collapse, destructive capacity finance or prolonged negative cash conversion.
Laifual.thesis_break: Volume is bought through price cuts, the new facility lacks utilisation, or harmonic-reducer architecture loses share.
Laifual.driver_split: Large operating earnings conversion plus continued growth valuation; unit shipments alone are insufficient.
Laifual.catalyst_sequence: Repeat humanoid orders -> margin/cash conversion -> high utilisation -> 800k-facility ramp and joint-module economics.
Laifual.downside_permanent_loss: Pre-profit valuation, ASP pressure, customer concentration and simultaneous capacity expansion create severe downside.
Laifual.correlation: Robotics/China; independent of memory and nuclear, but correlated with Namuga humanoid timing.

Impro.entry: HK$6.6–7.2 while FY26 growth and Mexico/cooling ramp evidence remain intact.
Impro.add: <=HK$6.3 with intact backlog, or after Mexico certification plus margin/cash confirmation.
Impro.trim: Above HK$10 before the earnings bridge reaches about HK$1.1bn or if an alternative offers better asymmetry.
Impro.sell: Reassess or exit on certification delay, guidance failure for thesis reasons, mix reversal or persistently poor cash conversion.
Impro.thesis_break: Capacity and working capital absorb the profit inflection or AI-linked cooling/power exposure reverses.
Impro.driver_split: Mostly operating earnings growth and mix; moderate rerating supplies the upper bridge.
Impro.catalyst_sequence: Mexico certification -> H2 cooling acceleration -> FY26 guidance delivery -> margin and free-cash conversion.
Impro.downside_permanent_loss: Diversified exposure reduces binary risk, but capital intensity and weak free-cash conversion can erode per-share capture.
Impro.correlation: Power/cooling; partially correlated with TAI-TECH and Modine but with distinct end-market engines.

Modine.entry: Fresh reassessment near $155–165 with thesis intact, or clean close and materially stronger post-spin EBITDA/FCF evidence.
Modine.add: Only after post-spin margin/FCF, multi-customer conversion and capacity-ramp evidence improve.
Modine.trim: If price capitalizes upside/stretch before margin and FCF arrive or concentration rises materially.
Modine.sell: Reject if the >$4bn agreement fails to convert economically, normalized FCF stays weak or separation impairs per-share value.
Modine.thesis_break: Data Centers margin fails to recover toward high teens/about 20%, customer demand breaks or capacity becomes commoditized.
Modine.driver_split: Operating revenue, margin and FCF recovery are primary; post-separation rerating is a secondary contributor.
Modine.catalyst_sequence: Transaction close -> continuing-company guidance -> margin recovery -> multi-customer capacity conversion and FCF.
Modine.downside_permanent_loss: Customer concentration, margin compression, separation complexity and another capital cycle can absorb strong demand.
Modine.correlation: Independent cooling engine, though still exposed to aggregate AI data-centre capex.

Centrus.entry: Fresh reassessment near $120–130 with DOE/customer/manufacturing thesis intact, or a disclosed funded-capacity bridge.
Centrus.add: Only as funded capacity, non-equity funding, manufacturing milestones and dilution-adjusted economics improve.
Centrus.trim: If valuation capitalizes upside/stretch before funded-capacity proof or dilution rises faster than funded value.
Centrus.sell: Reject if capacity remains unfunded/late, support weakens, milestones slip or equity becomes the dominant funding source.
Centrus.thesis_break: Expansion cost, dilution or customer/reactor delay overwhelms the strategic scarcity economics.
Centrus.driver_split: Mostly funding/schedule de-risking and franchise rerating inside the horizon; new-capacity earnings arrive later.
Centrus.catalyst_sequence: Funded tranche -> centrifuge manufacturing -> construction milestones -> firm customer schedules and dilution-adjusted value.
Centrus.downside_permanent_loss: Project finance, policy, warrant/convertible dilution and 2029 operating timing create material per-share risk.
Centrus.correlation: Best independent nuclear/policy engine; low correlation with HBM, cooling and robotics.

JEM.entry: <=about ¥6,100 with guidance/thesis intact, or investor-grade HBM4/HBM4E production evidence and 60%+ refreshed upside.
JEM.add: Only after production share, FY2028 earnings, FCF, utilisation or valuation improves without offsetting deterioration.
JEM.trim: When rerating outruns evidence/earnings or documented remaining-window upside falls below about 30%.
JEM.sell: Exit if HBM participation fails, another dilutive raise is needed or accounting earnings persistently fail to convert to cash.
JEM.thesis_break: Growth proves conventional-cycle leverage, important sockets are lost or existing capacity cannot support the horizon bridge.
JEM.driver_split: EPS/mix and cash conversion plus an HBM-evidence rerating; the post-horizon factory is excluded.
JEM.catalyst_sequence: HBM production disclosure -> FY2027 delivery -> FY2028 guidance -> existing-factory FCF without dilution.
JEM.downside_permanent_loss: Customer concentration, memory cyclicality, weak cash conversion and prior dilution limit per-share durability.
JEM.correlation: Memory/HBM; highly correlated with SUSS and the semiconductor capital cycle.

SUSS.entry: Fresh reassessment around €60–62 with backlog/process thesis intact, or stronger HBM process/backlog evidence.
SUSS.add: Only if backlog conversion, margin, HBM process share or qualification improves.
SUSS.trim: If rerating outruns earnings/evidence or a better independent engine offers superior asymmetry.
SUSS.sell: Exit on loss of a major process-of-record, architecture displacement or sustained conversion below the earnings path.
SUSS.thesis_break: Hybrid-bonding/process changes reduce content or 2027 backlog fails to convert at expected margins.
SUSS.driver_split: Backlog-led EPS/margin expansion plus some premium multiple retention.
SUSS.catalyst_sequence: Q3 execution -> 2027 backlog conversion -> HBM4/HBM4E process share -> hybrid-bond qualification.
SUSS.downside_permanent_loss: Customer/process concentration and architecture transition can reverse operating leverage quickly.
SUSS.correlation: Memory/HBM; correlated with JEM, so combined size needs an explicit cap.

portfolios.name: Current governed signals

two_failure_stress.assumption: zero terminal value for both; all other sleeves at base

portfolios.cash_deployment_condition: No deployment beyond the three 5% starters without an existing governed add or new-candidate trigger.

portfolios.name: Evidence-led deployment

two_failure_stress.assumption: zero terminal value for both; all other sleeves at base

portfolios.cash_deployment_condition: Deploy staged capital only after each existing price/evidence/event trigger fires; retain 46% cash until independent alternatives earn entry.

portfolios.name: Maximum credible asymmetry

two_failure_stress.assumption: zero terminal value for both; all other sleeves at base

portfolios.cash_deployment_condition: Reach documented maximum ceilings only after the associated proof gates; retain 24% cash for failed triggers, drawdown control or a demonstrably superior independent engine.

hurdles.requirement: All major staged triggers must fire, 76% of capital must become responsibly deployable, and the controlled maximum-asymmetry upside must improve by £1,560 through upper-band delivery or governed rotation.
Beyond the controlled upside, the remaining £9,600 cash would need about 5.33x by itself or several independent sleeves would need stretch outcomes plus successful rotation.
Beyond the controlled upside, the remaining cash would need about 9.50x by itself or repeated multi-bagger rotation without permanent-loss interruption.
The current governed underwrites provide no responsible path to the additional £121,560 above controlled upside; a cash-only bridge would require about 13.66x.
